title: ViewModel
description: The JSON a Rachana runtime returns for every screen (contract 1.x; version 1 keeps the reference implementation's field names). $defs.Frame is a frame event of the live stream. TRANSCRIBED BY READING from the reference implementation's Java records (Drishti engine/view/ViewModel, PanelData, ViewModelSchema; engine/live/Frame, Patch); REPLACED by the generated schema in R0 step H4. Each definition's x-java names its record and x-include its Jackson inclusion (ALWAYS: every component written, reference types nullable; NON_NULL, NON_DEFAULT, NON_EMPTY: components left out when null, default or empty, never null).
x-status: draft: transcribed by reading; replaced by the generated schema in R0 step H4

ViewModel.description: A bound view: everything a client renders, and nothing it must compute

mnemonic.description: the command mnemonic for the kind (TRD)

panels.description: panels in layout order; PanelView.area says which column

timings.description: stage timings in milliseconds (fetch, layout, bind, links, total)

controls.description: the Sutra's controls with their options and current values; left out when it declares none

selects.description: the panels whose rows or bars set a control when clicked; left out when none

layout.description: the Sutra's layout: (areas, columns, split, tabs, sections, sticky, arrange, phone) with each top-level panel's place ({place: {id: {area, order, section, collapsible}}}); absent: the panels flow

contract.description: the ViewModel contract this view speaks, major.minor (currently "1.0"); a client refuses a major it does not know and ignores what a newer minor adds

phone.description: what the Sutra says about the phone ({panels: {id: {tier, from, rows, columns, sort, series, figures, tab}}, order, default, summary}); left out when empty

Frame.description: One live-stream frame event: the patches that turn the client's view into the current one

latencyMs.description: latency of this frame in milliseconds

ev.description: on an hbar that emits on bar-click: the bar's row in the data

Bars.description: data of hbar: bars scaled to the largest absolute value

Bin.description: One bin: [from, to), the last one closed

Candle.description: One candlestick bar: the four prices and the volume as numbers (for the chart) and as text (for the Data table)

volumeText.description: the volume as text; absent without a volume

Candles.description: data of candlestick: open, high, low and close by date, oldest first

change.description: the change over the last bar, formatted

Cell.description: One formatted value: text, an optional label, tone, link and the document path it came from

link.description: when the value opens another entity

path.description: document path the value came from, for live patches

Chart.description: data of line and area: numeric series over x labels

source.description: the entity the points came from

step.description: drawn as steps (a value holds until the next point)

ControlView.description: A control as the reader sees it: what it is, the options they may pick (never a masked value), its value now and the panels that read it

kind.description: dropdown, multi-select, cascading, toggle, segmented, date, date-range, number-range, top-n or search

panel.description: the panel whose header holds it, for header placement

parent.description: the control a cascading one depends on

options.description: the choices (a date-range's are its presets, resolved on the calendar)

value.description: the current value (a range is from..to; empty when none)

values.description: the current choices of a multi-select

remember.description: whether the reader's last choice is kept

min.description: a number range's lower bound (from the data or fixed)

range.description: a slider with two handles (its value is from..to)

reads.description: ids of the panels (and strip or title) whose expressions read it

truncated.description: whether the options were cut at the limit

date.description: the date or timestamp as written

Fields.description: data of kv, status and provenance

value.description: the value; null when the document lacks it

GeoLink.description: What a click on the map opens

codes.description: the codes for which an entity exists: the others are not clickable

GeoMap.description: data of map: the world, or one country's regions, with a place highlighted, shaded by a measure, and clickable

highlight.description: the country to highlight as the document names it (an ISO code or a name)

region.description: for region mode, the country whose regions are drawn

link.description: what a click opens; absent when the map is only a picture

shade.description: the per-country figures that colour the map

GeoShade.description: The figures that shade a map

items.description: one figure per place that has one

note.description: why the map is not shaded (masked, no access, not read in time)

Graph.description: data of graph: nodes and the edges between them

edges.description: the relations; an edge to a node that is not listed is left out

layout.description: tree (layered from the roots) or force

more.description: nodes left out beyond the configured maximum

Histogram.description: data of histogram: bins computed on the server

bins.description: equal-width bins from the smallest value to the largest

dropped.description: values left out (not numbers, or beyond the configured maximum)

fmt.description: the format of bin edges and markers

label.description: what it does (Legs, Netting set, Raw JSON)

panel.description: target panel id for action panel

Level.description: One level a table's rows drill into (Sutra levels)

title.description: what the rows of the level are

numeric.description: per column, whether it is right-aligned

LinkItem.description: One entry of a links panel

status.description: resolved, pending, missing, denied or inactive

LinkView.description: A navigable link to another entity

mnemonic.description: command mnemonic for the target kind, when one exists

Marker.description: A marker line at a value

Metric.description: data of metric: one headline figure

value.description: the figure (its label is the panel's label)

delta.description: the change against a previous value, or null

caption.description: small text under the figure, or null

id.description: the node's identifier (the entity id when it names one)

focus.description: the node is the entity this view shows

Opt.description: One option of a control: the value that is set and the text shown

PanelCompute.description: The state of a panel whose source is a computed kind: never a blank panel

state.description: ready, computing, stale, failed or refused

requestId.description: the correlation id of this panel's read (its events go to this viewer only)

connector.description: the reactive connector that computes it

message.description: why it failed or was refused, or what it waits for; absent when ready

progress.description: the latest progress (done, of, a partial estimate)

hasResult.description: whether a result (current or last good) is shown

stamp.description: the result's stamp (pin, computedAt, engine, inputs)

PanelData.description: A panel's kind-specific content; which record depends on the panel's kind (PanelView.allOf pairs them)

PanelProvenance.description: How fresh a panel with its own source: is, apart from the page's

source.description: the connector that answered, or the source the document names

kind.description: the kind the panel's source reads

fetchedAt.description: when the source's document was fetched (ISO-8601); absent when it cannot tell

updatedAt.description: when the connector last received new data

PanelView.description: One panel: its id, kind and place, and its kind-specific data

kind.description: panel kind: one of the grammar's kinds; decides which record data carries

inferred.description: whether inference built or completed it

data.description: kind-specific content; null when the panel failed or is denied

error.description: set when binding this panel failed; the rest of the view is unaffected

empty.description: nothing to show (the document lacks what the panel asks for); the console says "No data available"

span.description: the Sutra's width for the panel in columns of a 12-column grid; absent: the whole column

height.description: the Sutra's height for the panel in grid rows; absent: as tall as its content

denied.description: set when the panel's source is an entity the caller may not open (no data, no error)

refresh.description: how often the console fetches the panel again

form.description: the panel's form: the fields as this viewer may edit them, the rules, the hints, the lookups' choices and, for a table, each row's values

provenance.description: freshness of the panel's own source

Patch.description: One change to a rendered view

op.description: strip, panel, provenance, deleted or restored

cell.description: the new strip cell, for op strip

panel.description: the new panel, for op panel

provenance.description: the new provenance, for op provenance

at.description: when the entity was deleted, for op deleted

Pivot.description: data of pivot: an aggregate of the rows by one field (down) and across another

by.description: the row field's name (the corner heading)

columns.description: the column keys, in first-seen order

rows.description: one per row key, in first-seen order

totals.description: the column totals and the grand total (last); absent when totals are off

more.description: row keys left out beyond the configured maximum

levels.description: the fields the rows group by, outermost first; present only when there is more than one

expand.description: levels shown open at first; present only with levels

across.description: the column field's name; present only with levels

cells.description: one per column: the aggregate formatted and toned

values.description: the aggregates (null where no row falls), for the heat scale and export

total.description: the row total; absent when totals are off

path.description: in a nested pivot, the keys from the outermost level down to this row

group.description: in a nested pivot, true for a group row (its cells are the subtotals of the rows after it that extend its path)

Point.description: A scatter point: its measures and their text, an optional size, label, group and the entity the label names

Provenance.description: How the view was built: layout, source, generation, business date, freshness and masks

layout.description: description of the layout, e.g. "Sutra irs-vanilla v3 + inference"

fetchedAt.description: ISO instant the source's document was fetched

businessDate.description: the business date the data is for; null when the source is not dated

updatedAt.description: when the source last received new data; null when it cannot tell

staleAfter.description: the source's staleness threshold (ISO-8601 duration), or null

sutra.description: the name of the Sutra that laid the view out, or null (inference alone); personal layouts are kept by it

masked.description: how many values the caller's field masks replaced (•••); 0 when none

maskedPanels.description: ids of the panels that hold masked values

partial.description: some of what makes the page did not answer (a grouped page gathered across nodes with a node down); written only when true

missing.description: one line per missing part when partial; left out when empty

Ref.description: An entity address as sent to clients

RefreshView.description: How often the console fetches a panel again (refresh: in the Sutra)

every.description: seconds between fetches: the fastest the reader may choose

userCanPause.description: whether the reader may pause it

path.description: document path of the row, for live patches

children.description: the rows nested under this one (Sutra children); absent for a leaf

pick.description: the value a click on the row sets in a control (on-select); absent when the panel does not select

crumb.description: on a table with levels: the row's name in the breadcrumb

kidsTotal.description: on a table with levels: the total row of the rows this one drills into

ev.description: on a panel that emits on row-click: the row's place in the data, sent back by a click

Scatter.description: data of scatter: one point per row

groups.description: the distinct groups, in first-seen order (a colour each)

more.description: points left out beyond the configured maximum

SelectView.description: A panel whose click sets a control: a table row sets the control to the value of its field; a bar sets it to its label

filter.description: the panels the author says it filters (those that read the control are rebuilt)

values.description: one value per x label; null where none

tone.description: the author's own word; free text

value.description: the signed contribution, or the level of a total

total.description: drawn as a full bar from zero

Surface.description: data of surface: z[row][column] over x and y

z.description: z[row][column]; null where the document has no number

fields.description: the tab's own fields (the tabs panel's body)

panels.description: the panels inside the tab (panels:), bound with @ the tab's element; absent without any

numeric.description: per column, whether it is right-aligned

search.description: the panel offers a filter box in its heading (Sutra option search: false turns it off)

pivot.description: the pivot the Sutra opts into (pivot:): its fields and the arrangement it opens with

expand.description: levels shown open at first (Sutra expand); present only on a tree

levels.description: the deeper levels a row drills into (Sutra levels); absent for a plain table

root.description: the first step of the breadcrumb (Sutra root)

emptyLabel.description: the words shown when there are no rows (Sutra empty); absent: the usual "No data available"

Timeline.description: data of timeline: dated events, oldest first

more.description: events left out beyond the configured maximum

with.description: counterparty text and link, or null

Tone.description: A theme tone; the console maps each to a colour token and pairs it with a sign or glyph. Used by Cell.tone, Bar.tone, Step.tone, Marker.tone, Event.tone and Candles.tone; Series.tone is the author's own word and stays free text

Waterfall.description: data of waterfall: ordered steps as floating bars

steps.description: in order; a total step is drawn from zero

Wire.description: What the console needs of a panel's Sutra wiring: the events a click fires, the words shown while it waits on an event, its groups of children and the source it reads

waits.description: set while the panel waits on an event not fired: what it says instead of data

children.description: per group of child panels: {place, show}

source.description: the kind (and pack) of the source it reads

parent.description: the parent panel's id for a child panel
